No text from reviews/L0-review-17.json, L0-review-lead-audit.json, L0-review-18-current.json, L0-review-011.json, L0-review-032.json or the citation-integrity review was reused or paraphrased; an existing L0 review file was opened only to read its JSON field names as a schema reference.

resolver_result_vs_row_claim.detail: SRC-004, SRC-040 and SRC-061 are exact matches at the row's own exact_locator plus an independent DOI/API resolver (Crossref 200, arXiv API 200). SRC-017 matches the INSPIRE record 1235595 (title, authors, year, volume/issue/pages, DOI) but the row's exact_locator is a query string containing literal ellipses and is not fetchable as written. SRC-043 matches at the arXiv abs page for title/authors/abstract, but that page does not carry the claimed Annals DOI or journal-ref; the claimed DOI 10.4007/annals.2015.181.2.6 was independently resolved via OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar to the same title/authors with pages 699-768, so the identity claim holds. Crossref endpoints for that one DOI returned 'unsupported content type' to the harness twice and were replaced by OpenAlex + Semantic Scholar; that tool-side failure is recorded, not counted as a row mismatch.

falsifier: Spot-checked row has a fabricated locator.
falsifier_note: No sampled row's locator resolved to a different work; no title/author/DOI substitution was observed. The strongest negative evidence is SRC-004, SRC-017, SRC-040, SRC-061 (8 independent resolver hits) and SRC-043 (OpenAlex + Semantic Scholar agreement with the arXiv record).

findings.finding: The exact_locator is 'https://inspirehep.net/api/literature?q=...Symmetries%20of%20cosmological%20Cauchy%20horizons...', which contains three literal '.' characters and is not a fetchable URL. The claim is still reproducible through evidence_url https://inspirehep.net/api/literature/1235595, which resolves to the correct record.
findings.remedy: Replace exact_locator with the canonical record URL; keep the query URL only as a search trail in a separate column.

findings.finding: status=verified-api while verification_method=primary-page-fetch: the two columns contradict each other for this row.
findings.remedy: Set status=verified-primary (the DOI was independently corroborated by two resolvers) or reconcile the two columns under one taxonomy.

findings.finding: The claimed published DOI 10.4007/annals.2015.181.2.6 and the journal reference are not observable at the row's exact_locator (https://arxiv.org/abs/1207.3164 shows no journal-ref and no related DOI). The DOI claim was corroborated only by adding OpenAlex/Semantic Scholar fetches, which are not recorded in the row.
findings.remedy: Record the DOI landing page (or the OpenAlex/Semantic Scholar identifier resolution) as evidence_url so the published-version claim is reproducible from the row alone.

findings.finding: The page range '309-630' in the venue string was not independently confirmed: the arXiv journal-ref gives volume 202, issue 2, September 2025 without pages, and the Crossref record for 10.4007/annals.2025.202.2.1 carries no page field. Not contradicted, just unverified.
findings.remedy: Cite the publisher landing page as the page-range source, or mark page ranges inherited from publisher metadata as not re-verified.

findings.finding: Quotes are normalized rather than verbatim: SRC-040 renders LaTeX '|a|/m\ll 1' as '|a|/m << 1'; SRC-017 silently repairs a whitespace artifact in INSPIRE's own abstract ('ruled byclosed' -> 'ruled by closed'). Neither changes meaning.
findings.remedy: Add a per-quote normalization flag (or quote the raw source string) so re-fetchers can diff exactly.

findings.finding: 0 fabricated locators in 5 sampled rows bounds the per-row fabrication rate only weakly: the one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound for 0/5 is approximately 45%. This audit passes the assignment's '>=3 independent re-fetches' acceptance test but cannot certify the remaining 92 of 97 rows.
findings.remedy: Extend to n>=20 stratified re-fetches with a fresh seed before treating citation integrity as established for G-LIT; keep the seed and strata frozen before fetching.

verdict_scope: This accept binds only to the assignment's re-fetch criterion at citation_audit.csv#315c19145065: every sampled row's locator resolves to the claimed work, so the assigned falsifier did not fire. It does not adjudicate, accept or revise the other open G-LIT items (self-certified rows, unresolved class tokens outside the frozen four, source_meta scope fields); those remain as recorded in controller_gate_audit and are outside this card.
acceptance_check: Independently re-fetched 5 (>=3) randomly sampled ledger rows; reported resolver result vs row claim row-by-row with exact fetched locators; verdict emitted. Stop rule satisfied: verdict submitted with the exact fetched locators.
next_falsifier: Re-run the same audit with n>=20 and a fresh frozen seed, stratified across primary-page-fetch vs API rows: the verdict is falsified if any sampled row's locator resolves to a different work, or if a claimed DOI/arXiv id maps to another title/author set, or if the exact_locator of any row is not a fetchable URL (the SRC-017 class of defect).
